text: SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT. Specimen: colon polyps, cold snare (x2). Gross: two tan polypoid fragments, 0.3 and 0.4 cm, submitted entirely. Microscopic description: sections show colonic mucosa with tubular adenoma, low-grade dysplasia. No high-grade dysplasia or invasive carcinoma. DIAGNOSIS: Tubular adenoma (x2), margins not assessable.

PATHOLOGY. Specimen: sigmoid polyp, forceps removal. Microscopic examination: serrated crypt architecture confined to the upper mucosa without cytologic dysplasia. DIAGNOSIS: Hyperplastic polyp. No adenomatous change identified.

Histopathology report, ascending colon polyp (snare). Microscopic description: dilated, boot-shaped crypt bases with horizontal growth. DIAGNOSIS: Sessile serrated lesion without dysplasia. Recommend surveillance per guideline.

SURGICAL PATHOLOGY. Specimen: rectosigmoid polyp, 1.6 cm, hot snare. Microscopic description: tubulovillous adenoma with focal high-grade dysplasia; stalk free of tumour. No invasive adenocarcinoma seen. DIAGNOSIS: Tubulovillous adenoma with high-grade dysplasia, completely excised.
PATHOLOGY ADDENDUM. Specimen received in the laboratory: colon polyps (2 containers), in formalin. Processing in progress. Final report to follow.
Laboratory notice: specimen 'colon polyp, transverse' accessioned. Slides pending review by the reporting pathologist. No diagnosis has been issued yet.
